archivedSpeaking.opening: 始める前に今日の計画を確認しましょう。資材はどこに仮置きしますか。
archivedSpeaking.goal: Run a two-minute morning brief covering work zones and material staging.

curriculumAdaptationNote: Preserve the 7:00 morning gathering, foreman question, Luis as crew lead, each person's assignment and work zone, material-staging location, any-hazard reporting, plan comprehension and questions before work. Keep crew lead and foreman distinct. The source does not establish universal job titles, temporary-only material storage or an approved safety/engineering plan. Archived forms and speaking remain unselected evidence. This packet creates no learner, audio, score or progress identity.

cards.reviewNote: Crew lead / jefe de cuadrilla and foreman / capataz are distinct roles in this brief. Confirm 班長 against 職長 and company role hierarchy without promoting either as a universal job title.
Área de acopio / staging area may be a designated material storage/staging area, while archived 資材仮置き場 narrows to temporary placement. Confirm site meaning and Japanese trade term.
Desmontaje / tear-off includes removal of the existing roof in the source note; archived 既存屋根材の撤去 may narrow to roof materials rather than the whole old roof scope.
Capataz / foreman must remain distinct from jefe de cuadrilla / crew lead. Confirm 職長 in this roofing crew hierarchy.
Plan del techo / roof plan is today's crew/work plan; archived 屋根の施工計画 may imply only installation planning. Confirm scope.
Peligro / hazard is any hazard, while archived 危険箇所 means a hazardous location. Confirm an inclusive Japanese term.
